about: Preview names both repos must agree on: the site repo's scripts/pages-previews.mjs (tests/pages-previews.mjs) and the source repo's .tools/deploy-preview.mjs (.tools/deploy-preview.test.mjs reads this file from site/). A name is v<major>-<minor>-<patch> of the build, optionally -<tag> (lowercase letters and digits, starting with a letter), at most 28 characters (the Cloudflare branch alias of riftborn-dev). accepted / refused: the name rule alone (null = no name at all). versions: a name must also start with v<version> of the build it holds (v2-4-0 or v2-4-0-<tag> for 2.4.0).
